objective: Prosecution-grounded 103 forensics. Determine WHY the 103 adversary disagrees with known prosecution outcomes. Build case-by-case forensic table comparing examiner vs system field-by-field. Do NOT simply make 103 more aggressive.

v3_4_frozen_results.root_cause: 103 accuracy 15% — adversary too lenient. COULD/WOULD rule correctly prevents false_elite but also prevents true positives on abandoned cases.

v3_5_changes_from_v3_4: CASE-BY-CASE 103 FORENSIC TABLE: for every case with known 103 outcome, compare examiner fields vs system fields

103 ERROR CLASSIFICATION (no generic MODEL_FAILURE): GROUND_TRUTH_EXTRACTION_FAILURE / SEARCH_FAILURE / REFERENCE_SELECTION_FAILURE / DIFFERENCE_IDENTIFICATION_FAILURE / MOTIVATION_FAILURE / EXPECTATION_OF_SUCCESS_FAILURE / TEACHING_AWAY_FAILURE / TECHNICAL_EFFECT_FAILURE / HINDSIGHT_FAILURE / FINAL_ADJUDICATION_FAILURE
EXAMINER_GROUND_TRUTH vs SYSTEM_INDEPENDENT_ANALYSIS: preserve both. If system has defensible alternative rationale, record ALTERNATIVE_REASONING. Do not force model to imitate examiner language.
3-Candidate closest prior art: construct >=3 candidates, score by technical_field/purpose/technical_effect/structural_similarity/functional_similarity, select CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART with provenance
DIFFERENCE VECTOR: CLAIM minus CLOSEST_PRIOR_ART. Every difference: element_id + exact_claim_span + prior_art_status + technical_significance

MOTIVATION evidence sources: EXPRESS_MOTIVATION / KNOWN_PROBLEM / DESIGN_PRESSURE / MARKET_ENGINEERING_CONSTRAINT / REFERENCE_TEACHING / ESTABLISHED_ART_KNOWLEDGE / PREDICTABLE_SUBSTITUTION. Record motivation_source + exact_passage + why_it_supports_combination. If no support: MOTIVATION_INSUFFICIENT.

EXPECTATION OF SUCCESS: separate CAN_WORK from EXPECTED_TO_WORK. Require technical basis: compatible_mechanism / compatible_operating_regime / known_substitution / same_function / established_design_principle / experimental_evidence / reference_teaching. No 'PHOSITA would know this' without evidence.
TEACHING AWAY: search explicit and implicit teaching-away signals. Record supporting_passage + contradicting_passage + strength.
TECHNICAL EFFECT: for each difference, record predicted_effect + documented_effect + unexpected_effect. If unexpectedly superior, record why.

ANTI-HINDSIGHT two-pass: Pass A (invention hidden) vs Pass B (invention visible). Compare problem_definition/reference_selection/motivation/difference/expected_success. If reasoning appears only after seeing invention: HINDSIGHT_HIGH.
PROSECUTION-CITED 103 ART RECALL: retrieve every substantive examiner-cited reference relevant to 103. Measure CITED_103_ART_RECALL (separate from overall cited-art recall).

103 SEARCH EXPANSION: search forward_citations / backward_citations / family_members / CPC_neighbors / same_assignee / same_inventor / same_technical_problem. Objective: determine whether system can find same or materially equivalent obviousness evidence.

MODEL SEPARATION: 103 searcher != 103 adversary != final adjudicator. Prefer SEARCHER_MODEL / OBVIOUSNESS_MODEL / ADJUDICATOR_MODEL. Adjudicator receives structured evidence, not searcher's conclusion.

SCORE EVIDENCE NOT CONFIDENCE: every 103 conclusion must have evidence_count + strongest_evidence + weakest_link + uncertainty + alternative_explanation. No model confidence field can substitute for evidence.
stop_rule: DO NOT run 50->5 until V3.5 reaches all thresholds including 103>=80%.
